title: Fees for professional or technical services, royalty, and non-compete fees

effectivePeriod.sunsetNotes: Transitions to Section 393(1) Table 6 Item (iii) of Income-tax Act, 2025 effective 1 April 2026.

plainTextSummary: Deduction of tax at source on fees paid to residents for: (a) Professional services (10%), (b) Fees for technical services (2% effective 1 April 2020), (c) Royalty for sale/distribution of cinematographic films (2%), (d) Other royalties and non-compete fees (10%). Threshold: ₹30,000 per financial year for each separate category. Reclassification Risk: If IT architecture/technical consultancy is reclassified by an Assessing Officer as managerial/professional advice, differential withholding of 8% plus Section 201(1A) penal interest (1% per month) attaches.

keyStatutoryThresholds.cbdtCircular23GstExclusion: TDS applies on basic service amount excluding separately stated GST.

officialCitations.subject: Reduction of TDS rate on Fees for Technical Services (FTS) from 10% to 2%
Exclusion of GST component from value of service for tax deduction at source

requiredDocumentChecklist: Vendor Agreement / Statement of Work verifying scope of work (Pure technical vs. managerial consulting)
Tax invoice with GST separately indicated
Lower-deduction certificate under Section 197 / Section 395 (if lower rate is claimed by vendor)
